scripts.install:all: pnpm install && pnpm --dir frontend install && cd backend && ./mvnw -q -DskipTests dependency:go-offline
scripts.dev: pnpm run dev:deps && concurrently -k -n api,web -c green,cyan "pnpm run dev:backend" "pnpm run dev:frontend"
scripts.dev:deps: docker compose up -d postgres redis minio
scripts.stop: docker compose stop postgres redis minio
